observations: Single solar panel photographed at an angle, leaning against an interior wall near a glass door.
Black-framed monocrystalline panel with visible half-cut cell pattern (horizontal split line across middle, typical of 120/144 half-cell panels).
A faint watermark overlay reads 'INNOSON GLOBAL GROUP' across the panel face — this appears to be the seller's business stamp, not a manufacturer brand printed on the panel itself.
No visible rating label, junction box sticker, or wattage/voltage plate on the back or frame.
No scale reference (ruler, person, or known object) to estimate physical dimensions.
Panel surface looks clean and unscratched, but this single partial-angle shot does not show corners, back junction box, or cables.

claims.claim: Contact us for ur Solar Energy Solution
claims.evidence: Generic business pitch in seller's text; not a specific, checkable claim about this item.

risks.risk: Wattage/power rating unknown — this is the primary price driver for solar panels and comparables range widely by wattage (42,000–155,000 NGN).
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the rear rating label/sticker showing Wp, Voc, Isc.
risks.if_unproven: Cannot be priced at all without this; no safe worst-case band can be chosen.

risks.risk: Brand/manufacturer unverified — watermark is the seller's company name, not a panel brand.
risks.proof: Clear photo of manufacturer logo/name printed on the panel or frame.
risks.if_unproven: Treat as unbranded/generic, priced at the lower end of comparable wattage bracket once wattage is known.

risks.risk: New vs used condition unverified — no shot of frame corners, backsheet, or junction box for wear, cracks, or hot-spot staining.
risks.proof: Photos of all four corners, the junction box/cables, and the backsheet.

risks.risk: Single unit vs lot — unclear if only one panel is for sale or a batch.
risks.proof: Wide shot showing full stock/quantity available.

proof_requests: Photo of the rear rating label showing wattage (Wp), Voc, Isc, and model number.
Photo of manufacturer branding/logo on the panel.
Photos of all four frame corners and the junction box/cables for condition check.
Confirmation and photo of quantity available (single panel or lot).
response.reason: The photo shows a generic unbranded-looking monocrystalline panel but no visible wattage, model, or rating label, and solar panel prices vary enormously by wattage; without that figure not even a worst-case price tier can be chosen.
